Subject: Need Information on Payment Refund

Hi Team, 

My name is Rohit and I am an aspiring engineer who bough your Lakshay batch slot starting on Oct 5th, 2026 this year. However, I realised that I don’t want to continue with this batch anymore and in fact don’t want to join pw at any capacity. 

I have been trying to reach out to your team for a cancellation and refund but is is of no use. Its been two weeks. I have also visited one of your centres to talk face to face, even they didn’t have a solution on this. Additionally, the employees there were extremely rude and kept on saying “Agar join nahi Karna the to Kharida kya? Hum nahi jaunt refund ya cancellation raise Hota hai, support se baat karo”.

Additionally, there is something wrong with your website. I tried opening it multiple times but it kept own crashing.

I am extreme angry and disappointed with the beviour of PW. I need my refund and a formal apology from your end for how your employees treated me. I cannot afford more delays, if I don’t get my refund by next week Monday, I will take legal action.
rows.note: Written blind by Arnav. Topics as written: Refund / Payment / Technical / Others - Rude behaviour by PW employees. Why: User mentions multiple things: Refund of payment ; Website Crashing ; Bad behaviour by employees. User threatens to take legal action if demands are not met.
reasons: Student at risk: Student is extremely angry, reports a repeated unresolved complaint for two weeks, complains of rude centre staff and threatens legal action if no refund by Monday.
Needs account/payment action: Student requests cancellation and refund of the Lakshay batch; unresolved for two weeks, needs account and payment lookup and refund processing.
Category 'other' is outside the knowledge base
rows.reply: Rohit, I'm sorry about the delays and the rude treatment at the centre; your frustration is completely understandable. Online batches are generally non-refundable, but a refund or batch-change request is never decided automatically: a support agent reviews it, checks your order against the policy and replies with a decision [RF-1][RF-4]. I can't promise a refund or a date by Monday, but PW aims to resolve support queries within 7 days [RF-4]. Your complaint about the staff's behaviour will also be handled personally by a support agent, and it helps to share the centre's name, the date of your visit and any messages or screenshots [RF-6][CT-3]. For the website crashing, please update the app to the latest version, and on Android clear the app's cache from Settings > Apps > Physics Wallah > Storage and restart the phone [TS-3]. If your concern is still unresolved, you can also write to support@pw.live with your ticket details [CT-5].
